data.narrative:
Alice & Bob is a Series B quantum computing company founded by Theau Peronnin and Raphael Lescanne, having raised €100M to date. The quantum computing sector comprises 11 comparable companies: 3 publicly traded (IONQ, RGTI, QBTS) and 8 private firms including Quantinuum, IonQ, D-Wave Quantum, Rigetti Computing, and Infleqtion.

Only one valuation method proved applicable. The Stage-Progression approach uses the €100M total raised as a proxy baseline and applies a 1.9x step-up multiplier typical of Series B advancement, yielding an implied valuation of €190M. A peer-median analysis was not feasible due to insufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables within the narrow quantum computing peer set—while six same-sector firms exist, none met the threshold of three or more datapoints when filtered by stage and valuation tier, making a narrow-peer median unreliable.

The triangulated valuation range spans €162M to €218M, with a median point of €190M. This single-method foundation creates material uncertainty around the valuation. Key risks include the limited applicability of stage-progression multiples to an early-stage, capital-intensive hardware sector where financing dynamics may diverge from typical SaaS or software benchmarks, and the absence of meaningful peer-relative valuation anchors. Investors should treat this range as indicative pending either acquisition of closer quantum-sector comparables or fundamental metrics tied to technical progress or revenue milestones.
